name: copy-button
title: Copy button
description: A button that copies a value to the clipboard, shows 'Copied' for a moment and announces it.
a11y: Native button; the icon-only form is named by the label prop (default 'Copy').
The result is announced in a polite role=status region: 'Copied' or 'Copy failed'.
The text button changes its visible text to the copied label and resets itself.
